数据组件

远端虚拟选择器 AsamRemoteSelectV2

在虚拟选择器上管理异步选项、重载和请求取消。

远端虚拟选择器 ​

在虚拟选择器上管理异步选项、重载和请求取消。

基础用法 ​

示例通过本地 Promise 函数加载选项，支持模型更新、暂停与重载。所有请求都留在演示内部。

点击“读取当前标签”读取实例的只读 selectedLabel：空模型返回空字符串，选择后返回当前标签。 完整说明。

本地数据与生命周期

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="multipleMode">启用多选</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			v-if="!multipleMode"
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			v-else
			ref="control"
			v-model="multipleValue"
			multiple
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<div class="demo-actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload">
				强制重载
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
				取消请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@mousedown.prevent
				@click="readSelectedLabel"
			>
				读取当前标签
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.focus()">
				聚焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@mousedown.prevent
				@click="control?.blur()"
			>
				失焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ multipleMode ? multipleValue : value }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="selected-label">{{ selectedLabel }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2BasicExample' });
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose, AsamApiRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Item {
	label: string;
	value: string;
	children?: readonly Item[];
}
interface Query {
	text: string;
}
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const active = ref(true);
const multipleMode = ref(false);
const multipleValue = ref<string[]>([]);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<string, Item>>();
const selectedLabel = ref<string | string[]>('');
function readSelectedLabel() {
	selectedLabel.value = control.value?.selectedLabel ?? '';
}
const error = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const items: readonly Item[] = [
	{ label: '准备', value: 'ready' },
	{ label: '进行', value: 'running' }
];
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Item[]> = async (params, context) => {
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
</script>

<style scoped>
.data-demo {
	display: grid;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
	justify-items: start;
}
.data-demo > p,
.data-demo > pre,
.data-demo > fieldset {
	width: 100%;
	min-width: 0;
	margin: 0;
}
.demo-actions {
	display: flex;
	flex-wrap: wrap;
	gap: var(--asam-space-md);
}
</style>

<style scoped>
p:where(.example-paragraph) {
	margin-block: 16px;
	line-height: 1.8;
	overflow-wrap: anywhere;
}
</style>

本地创建与完整实体 ​

allow-create 与 filterable 开启后，createOption(text) 同步返回完整的 AsamOption<V, I>（label、正确类型的 value 和真实 raw）。默认记录使用字符串 value； 数字、布尔值或自定义 raw 必须提供类型一致的同步工厂。

本地创建、规范项与来源重置

展开源码
场景源码 ZIP完整工程 ZIP
vue
<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-layout-1">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.clearCreatedOptions()">
				清空本地创建集合
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="value = null">
				清空模型
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="tenant = tenant === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a'"
			>
				切换逻辑来源
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="canonical">来源接受 Omega 同值项</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:debounce-ms="100"
			:create-option="createOption"
			value-mode="object"
			allow-create
			filterable
			clearable
			size="default"
			placeholder="输入 Omega 并选择创建项"
			@success="providerValues = $event.map((item) => item.value)"
			@error="message = $event.message"
		>
			<template #header><p class="example-paragraph">本地创建和来源选项分别保存</p></template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="example-paragraph">刷新保留本地项，逻辑来源改变时清空本地集合</p>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ message }}</p>
		<pre>模型：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre>工厂调用：{{ JSON.stringify(createdTexts) }}</pre>
		<pre>provider success 值：{{ JSON.stringify(providerValues) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamOption,
	AsamCreateOption,
	AsamValue,
	AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	tenant: string;
	text: string;
}
const tenant = ref('a');
const failure = ref(false);
const canonical = ref(false);
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2LocalCreationDemo' });
const value = ref<AsamOption<string, Member> | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<string, Member>>();
const createdTexts = ref<string[]>([]);
const providerValues = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const createOption: AsamCreateOption<string, Member> = (text) => {
	createdTexts.value.push(text);
	return { label: text, value: text, raw: { id: 'local-' + text, label: text, value: text } };
};
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示请求失败');
	const items: Member[] = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
	if (canonical.value) items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.text.toLowerCase()));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { tenant: tenant.value, text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	await nextTick();
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (result.value === 'success') message.value = '';
}
</script>

本地项不进入 provider/cache 或 success。相同类型、相同 value 去重，provider 同值 规范项优先；已经传给父组件的对象模型不会在刷新时自动替换。clearCreatedOptions() 清空本地集合及基础入口文本 memo，保留模型。

source(query) 中的查询变化、reload 和失败保留本地项；source('') 表示 query 中立 逻辑来源。 完整说明。

数据来源与覆盖 ​

source(query) 根据当前搜索文本创建 api 或 request 类型的 AsamOptionsSource，必须把 query 放进实际请求参数。它接管静态 options 和基础查询回调；不能同时传静态选项或第二个查询来源。示例通过本地 API 过滤标签，空文本返回完整列表。

单选值模式使用标量或 null；对象模式使用规范化 AsamOption。多选的数组与分隔字符串模式由 multiple、valueMode、multipleValueMode 联合约束；对象模式不能使用字符串存储。切换值策略时同时调整模型类型。

来源接管 options、loading 和远端查询；数据组件不开放基础选择器的 native 值模式。基础页中只使用与本组件公开分支兼容的能力。

生命周期、事件与实例 ​

active=false 暂停请求并保留上次成功数据；reload({ force: true }) 请求新数据，cancel() 取消当前请求。 完整说明。

immediate 控制初始化是否请求，active 控制请求是否启用。远端虚拟选择器的 debounceMs 默认 250，active 与 immediate 默认 true。

插槽与基础能力 ​

prefix、header、footer、empty、loading、tag、label 等插槽保留各自基础作用域；selectedLabel 为只读标签结果，focus/blur 用于焦点控制。虚拟选择器 default 插槽使用基础虚拟选项作用域。

动态项高的原生兼容范围 ​

estimatedOptionHeight 仍是本组件适用的公开属性，项高计算委托 Element Plus 2.14.7。 完整说明。

这是一项限定场景的原生兼容结果，内部原因仍未验证；本组件对应动态项高目的的实际 复验尚未完成。上述对照不替代高级动态路径验证，也不表示所有尺寸或其他动态配置失败。

异步查询与默认首项的原生兼容范围 ​

defaultFirstOption 仍是本组件适用的公开属性。 完整说明。

相同裸原生夹具省略等待期间的 loading 状态时，会高亮并通过 Enter 选择首个可选项。 这是限定的异步查询／loading 兼容结果，内部确切原因仍未验证；不能据此外推字典本地 筛选、所有异步时序或该属性的全部用途。来源加载与键盘选择仍按各自公开契约使用。

本站继承关系 ​

  • 虚拟选择器：适用的基础展示、交互与公开 API。

本页数据来源、模型、事件和实例的覆盖规则优先；本站链接不扩大本组件公开契约。尺寸使用基础组件的 ASAM 尺寸规则，示例使用 default。

选项和标签的完整展示 ​

完整示例在两个独立实例中演示虚拟选项模板、prefix/header/footer/loading/empty/label 和可删除 tag。 完整说明。

展示示例还逐次记录单选原始数字、多选原始数组的 update:modelValue/change，以及完整规范化选项的 success。可制造一次刷新失败，观察 error 的 kind/message 与旧选中值保留，再恢复；持有请求的取消不产生额外成功事件。每条记录保存独立载荷快照。

import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamSelectV2DataEmits,
	AsamValue,
	AsamDataError,
	AsamOption as DataOption,
	AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState, Member } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject<DemoState>('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state: DemoState = injected;
const singleControl = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<number, Member>>();
const singleValue = ref<number | null>(null);
type DataEmits = AsamSelectV2DataEmits<AsamValue, object>;
const dataEvents = ref<
	readonly {
		readonly mode: 'single' | 'multiple';
		readonly name: string;
		readonly payload: unknown;
	}[]
>([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode: 'single' | 'multiple', name: string, payload: unknown) {
	const snapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload: DataEmits['update:modelValue'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload: DataEmits['change'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload: DataEmits['success'][0]) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload: AsamDataError) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref<readonly number[]>([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref<readonly DataOption<number, Member>[]>([]);

const api: AsamApiRequest<{ text: string }, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) =>
	state.read(context.signal, params.text);
const factory = defineAsamOptions<number, Member>();
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value', disabled: 'disabled' }
	});
function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number;
	readonly id: number;
	readonly team: string;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
}
const rows: readonly Member[] = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	async function read(signal: AbortSignal, text: string) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref();
let app;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<script setup>
import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state = injected;
const singleControl = ref();
const singleValue = ref(null);
const dataEvents = ref([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode, name, payload) {
	const snapshot = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload, mode) {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload, mode) {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref([]);
const api = async (params, context) => state.read(context.signal, params.text);
const factory = defineAsamOptions();
const transform = (items) => items;
const source = (text) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value', disabled: 'disabled' }
	});
function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

js
import { ref } from 'vue';
const rows = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set();
	async function read(signal, text) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export function createDemoProvider(state) {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

局部请求错误插槽 ​

可选 error 插槽仅在当前请求错误存在时调用，接收只读 { error, stale, retry }。 完整说明。

retry 不接收参数，返回强制 reload 的 Promise，并遵守取消和卸载规则。 完整说明。

提供该插槽时，自有内容替换整个默认局部错误区；返回空内容也表示主动替换。 未提供时继续显示原错误文字、过期提示和默认重试按钮。无 error 的单独 stale 状态 不调用此插槽；empty、loading 和其他基础插槽继续使用原作用域。

以下完整 TS/JS 示例先制造失败，再等待插槽 retry 的返回结果；成功后可再次制造 更新失败，观察旧结果与模型保留。每次挂载使用独立子 app 和本地 provider。

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2ChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose, AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<string, object>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>().api({
	api: transport.api,
	params: undefined,
	transform: (rows) => rows,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots<string, object>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

ts
import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2ChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = defineProps({ transport: { type: Object, required: true } });
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref(null);
const control = ref();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions().api({ api: transport.api, params: undefined });
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(retry) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

js
import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		];
	};
	const provider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (_type, context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}

局部与全局浮层 ​

基础示例使用默认的全局挂载；局部挂载示例展示显式配置的 teleported 或 appendTo。先打开控件浮层，再观察其所在容器。挂载位置与控件值、请求协议互相独立。

<template>
	<section class="component-project" data-demo-host>
		<label
			>演示场景<AsamSelect
				:model-value="selected"
				aria-label="演示场景"
				@update:model-value="selectScenario"
				><AsamOption
					v-for="option in options"
					:key="option.value"
					:value="option.value"
					:label="option.label" /></AsamSelect></label
		><component :is="current" :key="selected" />
	</section>
</template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { computed, defineAsyncComponent, shallowRef } from 'vue';
import { AsamSelect, AsamOption } from '@asam-ui/ui';
const options = [
	{ value: 'basic/ts', label: '本地数据与生命周期 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'basic/js', label: '本地数据与生命周期 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'tag-colors/ts', label: '多选标签颜色 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'tag-colors/js', label: '多选标签颜色 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'local-creation/ts', label: '本地创建、规范项与来源重置 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'local-creation/js', label: '本地创建、规范项与来源重置 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'native-presentation/ts', label: '选项模板、标签折叠与加载插槽 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'native-presentation/js', label: '选项模板、标签折叠与加载插槽 (JS)' },
	{ value: 'local-error/ts', label: '局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复 (TS)' },
	{ value: 'local-error/js', label: '局部错误定制、等待重试与过期恢复 (JS)' }
] as const;
const scenarios = {
	'basic/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'basic/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/basic/js/Demo.vue')),
	'tag-colors/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tag-colors/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'tag-colors/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/tag-colors/js/Demo.vue')),
	'local-creation/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/local-creation/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'local-creation/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/local-creation/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'native-presentation/ts': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-presentation/ts/Demo.vue')
	),
	'native-presentation/js': defineAsyncComponent(
		() => import('./examples/native-presentation/js/Demo.vue')
	),
	'local-error/ts': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/local-error/ts/Demo.vue')),
	'local-error/js': defineAsyncComponent(() => import('./examples/local-error/js/Demo.vue'))
};
const selected = shallowRef<keyof typeof scenarios>('basic/ts');
function selectScenario(value: unknown) {
	const option = options.find((option) => option.value === value);
	if (option) selected.value = option.value;
}
const current = computed(() => scenarios[selected.value]);
</script>

<template>
	<section class="data-demo">
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="active">启用请求</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<!-- prettier-ignore -->
		<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="multipleMode">启用多选</AsamCheckboxItem>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			v-if="!multipleMode"
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			v-else
			ref="control"
			v-model="multipleValue"
			multiple
			:source="source"
			:active="active"
			size="default"
			placeholder="请选择或输入"
			@error="error = $event.message"
			@success="error = ''"
		>
			<template #prefix><span aria-hidden="true">状态</span></template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<div class="demo-actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="!active" @click="reload">
				强制重载
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.cancel()">
				取消请求
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@mousedown.prevent
				@click="readSelectedLabel"
			>
				读取当前标签
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="control?.focus()">
				聚焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="primary"
				native-type="button"
				@mousedown.prevent
				@click="control?.blur()"
			>
				失焦选择器
			</AsamButton>
		</div>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ error }}</p>
		<pre>{{ multipleMode ? multipleValue : value }}</pre>
		<pre data-testid="selected-label">{{ selectedLabel }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { ref } from 'vue';

defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2BasicExample' });
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose, AsamApiRequest } from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Item {
	label: string;
	value: string;

	selectedLabel.value = control.value?.selectedLabel ?? '';
}

];

	return items.filter((item) => item.label.includes(params.text));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({

		params: { text },
		transform: (response) => response,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}

<template>
	<section class="data-demo demo-layout-1">
		<div class="actions">
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="reload">强制重载</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="control?.clearCreatedOptions()">
				清空本地创建集合
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton type="primary" native-type="button" @click="value = null">
				清空模型
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="tenant = tenant === 'a' ? 'b' : 'a'"
			>
				切换逻辑来源
			</AsamButton>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="failure">模拟失败</AsamCheckboxItem>
			<AsamCheckboxItem v-model="canonical">来源接受 Omega 同值项</AsamCheckboxItem>
		</div>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			ref="control"
			v-model="value"
			:source="source"
			:debounce-ms="100"
			:create-option="createOption"
			value-mode="object"
			allow-create
			filterable
			clearable
			size="default"
			placeholder="输入 Omega 并选择创建项"
			@success="providerValues = $event.map((item) => item.value)"
			@error="message = $event.message"
		>
			<template #header><p class="example-paragraph">本地创建和来源选项分别保存</p></template>
			<template #footer>
				<p class="example-paragraph">刷新保留本地项，逻辑来源改变时清空本地集合</p>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status">{{ result }} {{ message }}</p>
		<pre>模型：{{ JSON.stringify(value) }}</pre>
		<pre>工厂调用：{{ JSON.stringify(createdTexts) }}</pre>
		<pre>provider success 值：{{ JSON.stringify(providerValues) }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { nextTick, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamCheckboxItem, AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamOption,
	AsamCreateOption,
	AsamValue,
	AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
interface Member {
	id: string;
	label: string;
	value: string;
}
interface Query {
	tenant: string;
	text: string;
}
const tenant = ref('a');
const failure = ref(false);
const canonical = ref(false);
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2LocalCreationDemo' });
const value = ref<AsamOption<string, Member> | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<string, Member>>();
const createdTexts = ref<string[]>([]);
const providerValues = ref<AsamValue[]>([]);
const message = ref('');
const result = ref('');
const createOption: AsamCreateOption<string, Member> = (text) => {
	createdTexts.value.push(text);
	return { label: text, value: text, raw: { id: 'local-' + text, label: text, value: text } };
};
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const api: AsamApiRequest<Query, readonly Member[]> = async (query, context) => {
	await new Promise<void>((done) => setTimeout(done, 150));
	context.signal.throwIfAborted();
	if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示请求失败');
	const items: Member[] = [{ id: 'server', label: 'Server', value: 'server' }];
	if (canonical.value) items.push({ id: 'saved', label: 'Server Omega', value: 'Omega' });
	return items.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(query.text.toLowerCase()));
};
const factory = defineAsamOptions<string, Member>();
function source(text: string) {
	return factory.api({
		api,
		params: { tenant: tenant.value, text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
	});
}
async function reload() {
	await nextTick();
	result.value = (await control.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	if (result.value === 'success') message.value = '';
}
</script>

<template><div ref="host" /></template>
<script lang="ts" setup>
import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';
import type { App } from 'vue';
import { provideAsamData } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import Child from './Child.vue';
import { createDemoState, createDemoProvider } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationDemo' });
const host = ref<HTMLElement>();
let app: App | undefined;
onMounted(() => {
	if (!host.value) return;
	const state = createDemoState();
	app = createApp(Child);
	app.provide('selection-presentation', state);
	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });
	app.mount(host.value);
});
onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

			>

			</AsamButton>
			<AsamButton
				type="default"
				native-type="button"
				@click="multipleLimit = multipleLimit === 3 ? 0 : 3"
			>

			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="multipleValues = [1, 3, 4]">

			<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" @click="multipleValues = []">
				清空多选模型
			</AsamButton>

		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			ref="singleControl"
			v-model="singleValue"
			:source="source"
			:debounce-ms="0"
			style="width: 280px"
			:fit-input-width="320"
			popper-class="data009-presentation-popper"
			clearable
			placeholder="演示单选"
			:teleported="false"
			@update:model-value="onModelUpdate($event, 'single')"
			@change="onModelChange($event, 'single')"
			@error="onError"
			@success="

				onSuccess($event);
			"
		>
			<template #prefix><span data-testid="presentation-prefix">前缀</span></template>

		<label>多选展示</label>
		<AsamRemoteSelectV2
			v-model="multipleValues"

			:debounce-ms="0"
			multiple
			:collapse-tags="collapseTags"
			:collapse-tags-tooltip="collapseTagsTooltip"
			:max-collapse-tags="maxCollapseTags"
			:multiple-limit="multipleLimit"
			:disabled="disabled"
			style="width: 280px"
			clearable
			placeholder="演示多选"
			:teleported="false"
			@remove-tag="removed.push($event)"
			@update:model-value="onModelUpdate($event, 'multiple')"
			@change="onModelChange($event, 'multiple')"
		>
			<template v-if="customTag" #tag="{ data, deleteTag }">
				<span data-testid="presentation-tag">
					已选 {{ data.length }} 项
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="disabled || !data.length"
						@click="deleteTag($event, data[0])"

<script lang="ts" setup>
import { inject, ref } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type {
	AsamSelectV2DataEmits,
	AsamValue,
	AsamDataError,
	AsamOption as DataOption,
	AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose,
	AsamApiRequest
} from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { DemoState, Member } from './provider.js';
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2NativePresentationChild' });
const injected = inject<DemoState>('selection-presentation');
if (!injected) throw new Error('Demo.vue must install its local provider before Child.vue mounts.');
const state: DemoState = injected;
const singleControl = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<number, Member>>();
const singleValue = ref<number | null>(null);
type DataEmits = AsamSelectV2DataEmits<AsamValue, object>;
const dataEvents = ref<
	readonly {
		readonly mode: 'single' | 'multiple';
		readonly name: string;
		readonly payload: unknown;
	}[]
>([]);
const eventResult = ref('');
function recordEvent(mode: 'single' | 'multiple', name: string, payload: unknown) {
	const snapshot: unknown = JSON.parse(JSON.stringify(payload));
	dataEvents.value = [...dataEvents.value, { mode, name, payload: snapshot }];
}
function onModelUpdate(payload: DataEmits['update:modelValue'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'update:modelValue', payload);
}
function onModelChange(payload: DataEmits['change'][0], mode: 'single' | 'multiple') {
	recordEvent(mode, 'change', payload);
}
function onSuccess(payload: DataEmits['success'][0]) {
	recordEvent('single', 'success', payload);
}
function onError(payload: AsamDataError) {
	recordEvent('single', 'error', { kind: payload.kind, message: payload.message });
}
async function failReload() {
	state.failure.value = true;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function recoverReload() {
	state.failure.value = false;
	eventResult.value = (await singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true }))?.status ?? 'cancelled';
}
async function cancelHeld() {
	state.held.value = true;
	const pending = singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
	setTimeout(() => singleControl.value?.cancel(), 30);
	eventResult.value = (await pending)?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	state.release();
}
const multipleValues = ref<readonly number[]>([1, 3, 4]);
const removed = ref<unknown[]>([]);
const customTag = ref(false);
const disabled = ref(false);
const collapseTags = ref(true);
const collapseTagsTooltip = ref(true);
const maxCollapseTags = ref(1);
const multipleLimit = ref(3);
const singleOptions = ref<readonly DataOption<number, Member>[]>([]);

const api: AsamApiRequest<{ text: string }, readonly Member[]> = async (params, context) =>
	state.read(context.signal, params.text);
const factory = defineAsamOptions<number, Member>();
const transform = (items: readonly Member[]) => items;
const source = (text: string) =>
	factory.api({
		api,
		params: { text },
		transform,
		fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value', disabled: 'disabled' }
	});
function holdAndReload() {
	state.held.value = true;
	void singleControl.value?.reload({ force: true });
}
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Member {
	readonly label: string;
	readonly value: number;
	readonly id: number;
	readonly team: string;
	readonly disabled?: boolean;
}
const rows: readonly Member[] = [
	{ label: 'Alpha', value: 1, id: 1, team: '一组' },
	{ label: 'Beta', value: 2, id: 2, team: '一组', disabled: true },
	{ label: 'Gamma', value: 3, id: 3, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Delta', value: 4, id: 4, team: '二组' },
	{ label: 'Epsilon', value: 5, id: 5, team: '二组' }
];
export function createDemoState() {
	const held = ref(false),
		empty = ref(false),
		failure = ref(false),
		calls = ref(0);
	const pending = new Set<() => void>();
	async function read(signal: AbortSignal, text: string) {
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		calls.value++;
		if (held.value)
			await new Promise<void>((done, reject) => {
				const finish = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					done();
				};
				const abort = () => {
					pending.delete(finish);
					signal.removeEventListener('abort', abort);
					reject(signal.reason);
				};
				pending.add(finish);
				signal.addEventListener('abort', abort, { once: true });
				if (signal.aborted) abort();
			});
		signal.throwIfAborted();
		if (failure.value) throw new Error('演示选择器请求失败');
		return empty.value
			? []
			: rows.filter((item) => item.label.toLowerCase().includes(text.toLowerCase()));
	}
	function release() {
		held.value = false;
		for (const finish of [...pending]) finish();
	}
	return { held, empty, failure, calls, read, release };
}
export type DemoState = ReturnType<typeof createDemoState>;
export function createDemoProvider(state: DemoState): AsamDataProvider {
	return {
		dict: {
			async refresh(context) {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
			},
			async get(type, context) {
				if (type !== 'presentation') throw new Error('Unknown local dictionary');
				return (await state.read(context.signal, '')).map((item) => ({ ...item }));
			}
		}
	};
}

import { createApp, onMounted, onBeforeUnmount, ref } from 'vue';

	app = createApp(Child);

	provideAsamData(app, createDemoProvider(state), { scope: 'native-presentation' });

onBeforeUnmount(() => app?.unmount());
</script>

<script lang="ts" setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2ChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose, AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import type { Transport, Item } from './transport.js';

const props = defineProps<{ readonly transport: Transport }>();
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref<string | null>(null);
const control = ref<AsamRemoteSelectV2Expose<string, object>>();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions<string, Item>().api({
	api: transport.api,
	params: undefined,
	transform: (rows) => rows,
	fieldNames: { label: 'label', value: 'value' }
});
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(
	retry: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots<string, object>['error']>>[0]['retry']
) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

import { ref } from 'vue';
import type { AsamDataProvider } from '@asam-ui/ui';
export interface Item {
	readonly id: number;
	readonly value: string;
	readonly label: string;
}
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		] satisfies readonly Item[];
	};
	const provider: AsamDataProvider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (
				_type: string,
				context: Parameters<NonNullable<AsamDataProvider['dict']>['get']>[1]
			) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}
export type Transport = ReturnType<typeof createTransport>;

				<div role="alert" data-testid="local-error">
					<p class="example-paragraph">{{ error.message }}（{{ error.kind }}）</p>
					<p class="example-paragraph" v-if="stale">已保留上次成功结果。</p>
					<AsamButton
						type="default"
						native-type="button"
						:disabled="busy"
						@click="recover(retry)"
					>
						恢复并重试
					</AsamButton>
				</div>
			</template>
		</AsamRemoteSelectV2>
		<AsamButton type="default" native-type="button" :disabled="busy" @click="failAgain">
			模拟更新失败
		</AsamButton>
		<p class="example-paragraph" role="status" data-testid="retry-result">{{ result }}</p>
		<p class="example-paragraph" data-testid="transport-count">
			请求 {{ transport.calls.value }} 次，字典刷新 {{ transport.refreshes.value }} 次
		</p>
		<pre data-testid="local-model">{{ value }}</pre>
	</section>
</template>
<script setup>
defineOptions({ name: 'AsamRemoteSelectV2ChildLocalErrorExample' });
import { ref, onMounted } from 'vue';
import { AsamButton, AsamRemoteSelectV2, defineAsamOptions } from '@asam-ui/ui';

const props = defineProps({ transport: { type: Object, required: true } });
const transport = props.transport;
const value = ref(null);
const control = ref();
const busy = ref(false),
	result = ref('');
const dataSource = defineAsamOptions().api({ api: transport.api, params: undefined });
const source = () => dataSource;
onMounted(async () => {
	const response = await control.value?.reload();
	result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
});
async function recover(retry) {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = false;
	try {
		const response = await retry();
		result.value = response.status;
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
async function failAgain() {
	busy.value = true;
	transport.failing.value = true;
	try {
		const response = await control.value?.reload({ force: true });
		result.value = response?.status ?? 'cancelled';
	} finally {
		busy.value = false;
	}
}
</script>

js
import { ref } from 'vue';
export function createTransport() {
	const failing = ref(true),
		calls = ref(0),
		refreshes = ref(0);
	const api = async () => {
		calls.value++;
		if (failing.value) throw Error('演示请求暂不可用');
		return [
			{ id: 1, value: 'ready', label: '准备' },
			{ id: 2, value: 'running', label: '进行' }
		];
	};
	const provider = {
		dict: {
			get: async (_type, context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				return api();
			},
			refresh: async (context) => {
				context.signal.throwIfAborted();
				refreshes.value++;
			}
		}
	};
	return { failing, calls, refreshes, api, provider };
}

# AsamRemoteSelectV2 全部场景

Node22.19+的22.x、pnpm11.9.0。在本目录执行pnpm install --frozen-lockfile、pnpm run typecheck、pnpm run dev、pnpm run build。vendor为固定正常包，保留锁文件和patches，不引用网站源码或借用node_modules。

界面中的场景选择器列出本组件全部真实TS/JS用法。src/examples/<场景>/<语言>/保留各场景原文件名、相对导入和资产；文件没有拼接进Demo.vue。主入口与所有场景配置也在文档的完整工程文件面板中。选择另一个场景会卸载前一个实例；文档中只切源文件则不会重挂载。

演示许可与第三方说明位于LICENSE、THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md及来源文件同目录的LICENSE-<摘要>.txt。

## Component compatibility sources and build helpers

Cascader, Image, ImageViewer and Anchor delegate their basic public behavior to
the installed Element Plus 2.14.7 components. ASAM supplies its styles and
documented advanced value adapters; it does not carry derived setup/render
implementations, bounded zoom, keyboard focus patches or Anchor scroll handling.

The former compatibility implementations used Element Plus gitHead
`77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`. Their original source identities
are retained here for historical provenance: the Cascader distribution module
SHA256 was `bac94ed4602841106d134f39056fdaca0d7fbb711fc8ff4339b7fac65391ea82`;
Anchor source `packages/components/anchor/src/anchor.vue` SHA256 was
`3a60f68d455f3e582ecffd4639c78ee24fcbf0a2bcfe0ce0cddf03583d78af2f`.
These historical identities do not imply that the derived runtime remains in
this native-delegation candidate. The original Element Plus license follows.

Build helper inputs are pinned to VueUse core 15.0.0, Element Plus Icons Vue
2.3.2 and Lodash ES 4.18.1. Other components may still use these helpers;

following original notices remain applicable to retained source and helper

## Private declaration snapshots

The normal declaration build redistributes 590 Element Plus 2.14.7 ES declarations
and 295 Element Plus Icons Vue 2.3.2 declarations under `dist/_upstream`.
The original declaration and producer-patch hashes, module-path adaptations and
output hashes are recorded in `dist/_upstream/provenance.json` and the build input
`tools/eng-006/upstream-declarations.lock.json`. The fixed Element Plus source
identity is `77d5c32c4ebcfffde67e51f6325c6d350ca668a0`.

Eight Element Plus declarations receive the recorded strong-type corrections.
Relative declaration references use explicit NodeNext extensions. The Color
class, installation key, table placeholder key and loading directive declaration
are exact re-exports of the original peer declaration leaves, preserving private
member and unique-symbol identity. These snapshots have no runtime entry point.

The complete original MIT licenses are redistributed with each declaration
snapshot at `dist/_upstream/element-plus/LICENSE` and
`dist/_upstream/icons-vue/LICENSE`. The Element Plus and Icons Vue copyright and
license texts above also apply to these declaration derivatives. External type
providers remain normal installed dependencies; their declarations are not
copied into these snapshots.

用法与契约补充说明 ​

基础用法 ​

点击“读取当前标签”读取实例的只读 selectedLabel：空模型返回空字符串，选择后返回当前标签。focus() 与 blur() 为无参数方法，仅控制输入焦点，不改写模型；失焦按钮阻止鼠标按下时抢走焦点，以便观察 blur() 的实际作用。勾选“启用多选”切换到独立数组模型；空选择读取空数组，选择多个选项后返回标签数组，输入焦点方法仍不改写模型。

本地创建与完整实体 ​

source(query) 中的查询变化、reload 和失败保留本地项；source('') 表示 query 中立 逻辑来源。真实 source owner、基础参数、字段策略或 provider/scope 变化自动清空。 source('') 也必须能构造有效来源。需要清空模型时由调用方另行更新 v-model。

生命周期、事件与实例 ​

active=false 暂停请求并保留上次成功数据；reload({ force: true }) 请求新数据，cancel() 取消当前请求。success 返回规范化选项数组，error 返回 AsamDataError；旧成功数据更新失败时组件显示过期状态。reload 的 status 为 success、error 或 cancelled；不能把取消当作成功。

动态项高的原生兼容范围 ​

estimatedOptionHeight 仍是本组件适用的公开属性，项高计算委托 Element Plus 2.14.7。 已观察到一个裸原生 ElSelectV2 对照：500 个平面选项、单选空模型 null、 filterable=true、height=120、itemHeight=34，另设 estimatedOptionHeight=34 时， 公开挂载及 nextTick 未在 10 秒观察窗口内完成。同一输入省略该属性后，裸原生正常挂载， 并完成列表底部／顶部滚动和数值 0 的选择。

异步查询与默认首项的原生兼容范围 ​

defaultFirstOption 仍是本组件适用的公开属性。Element Plus 2.14.7 的一个限定对照中， 自动远程查询开启该属性，输入 Al 后等待异步结果；结果包含首个禁用项及两个可选项。 高级远端虚拟选择器与使用公开 remoteMethod、options、loading=true 等待结果的 裸原生 ElSelectV2 均在回包后未自动高亮可选首项，此时 Enter 保持空模型且不产生模型 事件；ArrowDown 后再按 Enter 可以选择首个可选项。

选项和标签的完整展示 ​

完整示例在两个独立实例中演示虚拟选项模板、prefix/header/footer/loading/empty/label 和可删除 tag。来源仍返回规范化的平面实体；虚拟选择器的数据入口不接收原生分组 options，对嵌套原生 options 的需求由基础虚拟选择器 native 模式承接。多选使用原始数值数组，保留折叠标签提示、maxCollapseTags、multipleLimit 和 disabled；自定义 tag 通过原生 deleteTag 删除并触发 remove-tag，不直接改内部标签。完成请求按钮释放本地等待操作，便于观察真实 loading 与 empty 插槽；卸载时请求随独立子应用取消。虚拟选择器使用 fitInputWidth=320 设置弹层宽度。

选项和标签的完整展示 ​

控制按钮可关闭并恢复 collapseTags 与 collapseTagsTooltip，切换 maxCollapseTags=1/3 与 multipleLimit=3/0。取消上限后可实际选择第四项，调用方恢复 [1, 3, 4] 后恢复上限；折叠和提示设置不改变模型或新增来源请求。原生 deleteTag 与 remove-tag 保留数值载荷。

局部请求错误插槽 ​

可选 error 插槽仅在当前请求错误存在时调用，接收只读 { error, stale, retry }。 error 与本实例 error 事件中的 AsamDataError 为同一对象，保留 cause、kind、 message 与 notified；渲染插槽不会再次通知 provider。stale 表示保留的数据已过期。

更多参数与事件说明 ​

局部请求错误插槽 ​

retry() 不接收参数，直接返回现有 reload({ force: true }) 的 Promise，结果为 AsamReloadResult<readonly AsamOption<V, I>[]> 的 success、error 或 cancelled 分支。 重试遵守 active、当前来源、取消和卸载规则，不改写模型。

继承能力

本入口的独有 API 见上表，基础能力见本站对应页面。

type PublicContract<V extends AsamValue = AsamValue, I extends object = object> = {

	"prefix"?: (() => unknown) | undefined;
	"tag"?: (AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots<V, I>)["tag"];
	"label"?: ((scope: { index: number; label: AsamSelectV2NativeProps["modelValue"]["label"]; value: AsamSelectV2NativeProps["modelValue"]["value"]; }) => unknown) | undefined;

	"loading"?: (() => unknown) | undefined;
	"header"?: (() => unknown) | undefined;
	"footer"?: (() => unknown) | undefined;
	"error"?: (AsamRemoteSelectV2Slots<V, I>)["error"];
};

clearCreatedOptions() 只清空组件本地创建项和基础入口文本 memo，保留 v-model 与 provider/cache。query 中立来源参数或 source owner、scope 改变自动清空； 搜索、刷新及错误不会清空。source('') 必须可构造同一来源的无查询描述符。
